newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BANCO MELLO SURGES ON H1 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: BANCO MELLO SURGES ON H1 RESULTS.

text.p: Portugal's Banco Mello surged to hit a new all-time high of 1,610 escudos after the bank announced strong growth in its first-half profits.
At 0900 GMT the stock was up 119 escudos at 1,610 on volume of 131,800. Dealers said the shares might meet resistance at this level but the medium-term price target was 1,700 escudos.
"Banco Mello performed well in the first half, proving that its recovery is well under way. The market has woken up to a good buy opportunity," said one trader.
Banco Mello on Wednesday announced that its first-half consolidated net profit had risen 800 percent to 1.379 billion escudos from 153 million.
